chunks.title: Who is Matheus?
chunks.text: Matheus Silvano Pereira is an AI Developer based in Florianópolis, Brazil. He builds applied AI products end to end: LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, FastAPI services and production observability. He is an Information Systems student at UFSC (2024-2028).
chunks.tags: who about summary bio introduction background

chunks.title: Current job at Dígitro Tecnologia
chunks.text: Since Feb/2026 he is an AI Developer at Dígitro Tecnologia (on-site, Florianópolis). He builds enterprise generative-AI solutions with LLMs and orchestration patterns (tools, routing, memory, fallback) to automate internal flows and raise operational efficiency. He started there as an AI developer intern (Apr/2025 to Jan/2026).
chunks.tags: work job company current employer digitro experience role

chunks.title: RAG and retrieval work
chunks.text: He implemented end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion and normalization, chunking, embeddings, a vector store and re-ranking, to raise answer precision and reduce hallucinations in production. As an intern he also built a re-ranking evaluation pipeline with test datasets, metrics and technical reports to pick the most accurate retrieval models.
chunks.tags: rag retrieval embeddings chunking rerank re-ranking vector hallucination search llm

chunks.title: Telephony conversational bots
chunks.text: At Dígitro he developed conversational bots for telephony, including call-transfer flows and emergency-call classification, using LLMs integrated with IVR (URA) systems to improve routing and response. He also built no-code-driven agents that generate IVR code and configuration with FastAPI and LangChain, cutting delivery time by about 2 days.
chunks.tags: telephony voice phone bots ivr ura calls emergency agents langchain no-code

chunks.title: LLM evaluation and observability
chunks.text: He built an internal LLM evaluation framework (quality, cost and latency metrics, comparative tests of models, embeddings and re-rankers) to support data-driven architecture decisions. He also added observability to AI apps: structured logging, per-request tracing and latency/cost metrics.
chunks.tags: evaluation eval observability metrics latency cost tracing logging monitoring benchmark

chunks.title: APIs and backend
chunks.text: He models and integrates services between LLMs and internal APIs using FastAPI (REST) with schemas, versioning and error handling. Backend stack: FastAPI, REST, Webhooks, JWT/OAuth2, OpenAI API, LLM API integration. Databases: PostgreSQL, Oracle (PL/SQL), MySQL, Redis, Qdrant, pgvector.
chunks.tags: api backend fastapi rest database postgres redis qdrant pgvector oauth jwt sql python

chunks.title: Smart Pricing (SaaS)
chunks.text: Since Nov/2025 he works remotely as a full-stack and AI developer on Smart Pricing, a SaaS for vacation-rental hosts. He built pricing/occupancy/performance dashboards in React, a multi-tenant FastAPI REST API, pricing automations (unbooked-days and occupancy-gap rules), integrations with external APIs, ADR/occupancy/REVPAR metrics, alerts for negative reviews, and an AI proof of concept for automatic insights. The product serves portfolios of 30+ properties.
chunks.tags: smart pricing saas react dashboard pricing startup full stack multi-tenant airbnb pricelabs

chunks.title: Fonte (automations)
chunks.text: From Feb/2026 to Apr/2026 he built automations and AI workflows for Fonte: an n8n workflow integrated with the WhatsApp Cloud API, OpenAI and Trello that turns group messages into structured, validated tasks, with Redis-based duplicate control, automatic deadlines and error handling.
chunks.tags: fonte n8n whatsapp trello automation workflow redis openai

chunks.title: Nexxera
chunks.text: At Nexxera he started as an implementation apprentice (Jan/2022 to Dec/2023) and became implementation operator (Dec/2023 to Apr/2025), automating routines with Python and Shell Script and validating corporate data with SQL.
chunks.tags: nexxera implementation apprentice automation shell python early career

chunks.title: Mooose (essay grading platform)
chunks.text: Mooose is an AI platform in production that grades ENEM essays with LLMs and RAG, giving criterion-by-criterion feedback. It has graded 1000+ essays. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Docker, RAG/LLMs, PostgreSQL, React and Vue front-end.
chunks.tags: mooose enem essay grading education project product saas

chunks.title: Other projects
chunks.text: Real-time face recognition (Python, OpenCV, NumPy), a toxic-content detector (Python, scikit-learn, pandas, Streamlit) and Limpa CNPJ, a Chrome extension with 170+ active users.
chunks.tags: projects face recognition opencv toxic nlp chrome extension limpa cnpj

chunks.title: Skills and tools
chunks.text: Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Shell Script, Lua. AI and GenAI: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, model evaluation, LangChain. DevOps: Docker/Compose, Linux, CI/CD, monitoring and logs, deploy on Render/Vercel. Tools: Git (GitHub/GitLab), Postman, Grafana, Jira, Scrum/Kanban.

Awards: OBMEP honorable mention (2019, 2022) and ONC silver medal (2022).
